description: This file defines the LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Leave plugin. It extends a date range filter class and includes functionality for setting and retrieving filter parameters related to leave requests, such as statuses, employee numbers, subunit IDs, and leave types. It also manages sorting behavior and current employee inclusion options.

classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used for filtering and sorting leave request records within the Leave plugin. It supports parameters such as statuses, employee identifiers, subunit, and leave type, along with sorting options.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses currently set for filtering.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses filter, validating against allowed statuses and converting them via a status map obtained from the leave request service.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Gets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current includeEmployees setting, indicating whether to include current, past, or both categories of employees.
